beats: Imagine firing an employee, but they still show up and sometimes run the meeting.
That's what was happening to one of my automated agents. A retired one kept waking up on its own schedule.
Sometimes it even won the leader election and took over control with old, outdated code.
Now every agent sends its identity with each request, checked against a disabled list on Cloudflare Workers.
Any retired id gets rejected instantly, every time, with a 403.
